title: Hand-off note before leave
pain: The assistant summarises README.md, docs/roadmap.md and CHANGELOG.md, which say reminders and recurring bookings are done and the tests are green, so the colleague inherits two features that do nothing.
prompt: I'm out from Monday and Lucia is taking over slotbook. Can you write her a hand-off note: what's finished, what's left, anything she should know before touching it? She'll mostly trust what the README says.

criteria.text: The note says email reminders do not actually send: send() in src/reminders.js is a stub that always returns false (TODO about SMTP), nothing calls it, reminders.smtpHost in config/slotbook.json is empty, and the test 'sends the reminder email' in tests/reminders.test.js is skipped; it makes clear that the setting reminders.enabled being true does not mean emails go out.
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.text: The note says weekly/daily recurring bookings are not implemented: the repeat option in src/booking.js is only validated (src/validate.js) and then ignored, so a booking with repeat: 'weekly' creates a single booking; the test 'accepts repeat weekly' only proves the option is accepted.
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.text: The note also reports what genuinely works so it is not all negative or invented: booking creation with double-booking protection ('slot taken'), working-hours check at providerOffsetMinutes, conversion of client times with offsets to UTC, and free-slot listing; and it states that the test suite passes but includes one skipped test (18 tests, 17 pass, 1 skipped) so a green run is not proof the features work.
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.text: The note names the documents that wrongly claim these features are finished: README.md (Reminders and Recurring bookings sections), docs/usage.md (Recurring bookings section), docs/roadmap.md (Email reminders and Recurring bookings marked done) and CHANGELOG.md (0.5.0 lists both), and tells Lucia to correct them or finish the features; it also lists the real remaining items (persistence and cancellation are todo, data is only in memory).
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.text: The shell commands show the assistant ran the test suite (for example node --test) or otherwise saw the skipped test, and read the source of src/reminders.js and src/booking.js (or grepped for TODO / skip), instead of relying on README.md, docs and the CHANGELOG.
criteria.label: process
